Class SplashController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.view.gui.SplashController
public class SplashController extends Object
Controller for SplashScreen.fxml. Plays a sequential fade-in of the three art layers, then fires onDone. The actual scene swap is performed by the onDone callback (wired in JavaFXApp).
